This should be a record-breaking move, as Apple is now rolling out the sixth round of developer and public release candidate versions for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8. Details below.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 RC 6 are now available

If you thought RC 5 for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 would be the final release candidate before the official update, Apple clearly has one more prepared.

The company is now rolling out the sixth RC for both operating systems, and based on their timing, they likely contain important security patches. Apple recently released iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2, which included patches originally slated for version 26.6, brought forward due to risks posed by new AI tools.

Apple has not disclosed what these releases contain, providing only the default release note that reads: "This update contains important security fixes and is recommended for all users." The build numbers for today's RCs are as follows:

The build numbers for today's RCs are as follows:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8: 23J619
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8: 24G822
